purpose: Reconstruct 180 source descriptive Gaussian TBW values without using inferential p values to choose procedures.
published_definition: Gaussian standard deviation fitted to yes-response proportions; exact fitting equation and constraints not in inspected main Methods.
known_v01_obstacle: Three-parameter zero-baseline Gaussian fit did not reproduce source widths; official publisher numeric blocks match source counts and widths.
candidate_axes: Gaussian sigma vs sqrt(2)*sigma, FWHM, HWHM, 2*sigma
height vs area amplitude (equivalent unconstrained parameterizations)
BCI prediction-derived Gaussian widths vs direct descriptive fitting
task/condition spreadsheet mapping and source-released code identity
evaluation: Compare every reconstructed width with its source row and condition, retain numerical residuals and all candidate definitions; do not relabel participants to maximize agreement.
output_precision: Source widths have 5 decimal places; record max/median absolute ms error and counts within 1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2 and 1 ms. Exact reconstruction requires an identified estimator and rounding-level agreement, not merely high correlation.
inference: No revised scientific significance tests or bootstrap until source estimator clarified and parent coordination.
